scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your foe’s weapon scrapes along your skull, tearing a long hideous furrow through your scalp. Your whole head is soon covered with blood.

Effects: You gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and @Condition[Blinded] (2). If you ask your GM nicely he may allow the hair along the scar to come out pure white, giving you a dashing white streak to set you off from the common crowd.
